categories.main_business_segments: Chia Chang Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of metal stamped components for TFT-LCD products, including back covers, bezels, heat sinks, inverter covers, shielding plates, and small-sized parts. The company serves diverse applications such as LCD TVs, notebooks, monitors, tablets, automotive displays, industrial computers, networking, and server products. It also extends its business into medical, networking, and server industries to diversify revenue sources.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in precision metal stamping and mold development, integrating design and manufacturing capabilities. It employs advanced automated stamping equipment and rapid mold change systems to enhance production efficiency and cost competitiveness. Surface treatment processes comply with RoHS standards, and the company continuously improves thin sheet processing technology and automation to meet customer demands for lightweight, thin, and integrated metal components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major Taiwanese, Chinese, and Korean panel manufacturers and global backlight module suppliers. The end markets served encompass consumer electronics (3C), automotive displays, networking products, medical devices, and industrial computing. The company supports international brand clients and focuses on high-value-added products to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.geographic_coverage: Chia Chang operates manufacturing facilities and subsidiaries in Taiwan, China (Suzhou, Ningbo, Nanjing, Chongqing), and Vietnam. The company’s sales are primarily concentrated in Mainland China (over 75% of revenue) and Taiwan (around 23%). It is strategically expanding production capacity in Vietnam to enhance global supply chain flexibility and competitiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing metal stamped components and assemblies used by panel makers, backlight module manufacturers, and system integrators. It provides integrated services from mold design and manufacturing to stamping and assembly, supporting downstream electronics and automotive product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Chia Chang emphasizes continuous innovation in precision stamping and mold development, focusing on automotive applications, networking, servers, and automotive display products. It invests in automation and smart factory initiatives to reduce costs and improve quality. The company also pursues product integration and diversification to increase added value and mitigate industry cyclicality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of metal stamped components and assemblies to panel manufacturers, backlight module suppliers, and system integrators. The company operates on a contract manufacturing basis, fulfilling orders for various electronic and automotive display products. It also derives income from strategic investments in related businesses.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chia Chang holds a competitive position in the metal stamping sector for display and automotive components, leveraging its mold design expertise, production scale, and geographic footprint. It faces competition from other regional metal stamping suppliers, especially amid pricing pressures from Chinese competitors. The company maintains competitiveness through lean management, automation, and quality assurance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$5.67 billion, a 7% decrease from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to owners of about NT$592 million. It has a stable asset base exceeding NT$11.8 billion and continues to invest in fixed assets and automation. R&D expenses increased to 2.5% of revenue, reflecting a focus on innovation despite market challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chia Chang differentiates itself by offering integrated precision stamping solutions with strong mold development capabilities, enabling rapid product development and high-quality output. Its comprehensive service from design to assembly reduces customer supply chain complexity and cost. The company’s geographic presence and flexible production capacity enhance responsiveness to global market demands, while its commitment to sustainability and social responsibility adds corporate value.
